From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership flags: QBR priorities, urgent risks, and one‑page asks

Team —

Quick leadership update ahead of next week's QBR prep meeting. Intended to be terse: wins, top risks, and the specific asks I want from each function by EOD next Wednesday (4/7). Please read and reply inline if you have clarifications.

WINS (last 30 days)
- Hosted API latency improvements: 12% median tail reduction (runtime tuning + batching); ops reports steady for GA customers.
- Dedicated: 2 new Reserved Capacity contracts closed (Acme, Helix) — adds ~120 GPU-hours/week to committed pool.
- Optimize: first pass quantization profiles reduced cost/unit for embedding-heavy workloads by ~18%.

TOP RISKS (impact and mitigation)
1) Acme procurement gap (high impact, near-term)
   - What: Legal redlines on data-retention clause + missing PO.
   - Impact: Delays on Dedicated onboarding (revenue recognition next quarter).
   - Mitigation in progress: Contracts team has a live thread with Acme and ProcureCloud (cc'd). Need procurement to confirm PO arrival timeline.
2) SOC2 evidence lag for Private deployments (medium)
   - What: Several evidence artifacts still outstanding for customer audits; security has most items but needs one-time consolidated package.
   - Impact: Customer readiness for Private/on-prem sales.
   - Mitigation: Security preparing an evidence bundle (see attachment list).
3) QBR deck gaps (low→med)
   - What: Metrics slice for latency by tenant and cost-per-1k tokens for top 10 customers missing from slides.
   - Mitigation: Data and analytics are pulling a targeted export.

ASKS (owners + deadline)
- Markus (SRE/Runtime): send a 1‑page note with SLA variance explanation and the 95/99 tail numbers by 4/7 COB. Attach to the QBR one-pager.
- Laura (Go-to-market): confirm Acme renewal timeline and whether Sales can accept partial PO / pilot order by 4/5 EOD.
- Lauren (Legal/Contracts): clarify which redlines are non-negotiable and provide a suggested short amendment for Acme by 4/6.
- Jonas (Finance): confirm when PO #4521 will be received and if revenue recognition needs deferral (email me and copy laura) by 4/6.
- Aditya (Security): deliver SOC2 evidence bundle stub (zip) and ETA on final items by 4/7.

Attachments: QBR_one_pager_v1.pdf (draft), SOC2-evidence-summary.zip (partial) — I'll upload a revised deck after I get Markus' numbers.

Goal for next week: produce a single page per theme for execs (1-pager + 10-slide appendix). I'll stitch together slides on Friday and send the final pack to the board.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
VP, Product Operations | Redwood Inference

Team —

Thanks for the quick turns. Consolidated status and what I’ll present to the execs: please treat this as the finalized leadership update unless you send corrections by EOD tomorrow.

Finalized WINS
- Latency tail improvements: 12% median tail reduction (runtime kernel + batching). I'll include the Hosted vs Dedicated slice if Markus delivers numbers by tomorrow morning.
- New committed business: Acme signed a pilot PO; procurement expects full PO w/in 30 days.
- Cost improvements: Optimize reduced embedding costs by ~18% on targeted workloads.

Open Risks (current mitigation/next step)
- Acme legal redlines: Lauren to send recommended amendment (still pending). If not resolved by 4/10, we route to me and legal for escalation.
- SOC2 evidence: Aditya — please confirm final zip contains audit manifest and timestamped artifacts by 4/10.
- Revenue recognition: Jonas — confirm if PO timeline forces deferral (need an answer by COB 4/9).

Final asks (what I'll present and who I expect to be on the hotseat)
- Markus: SLA variance + tail numbers (Hosted/Dedicated) — deliver by 4/9 09:00PT.
- Lauren: final amendment language and summary of negotiable vs non-negotiable redlines — deliver by 4/10 12:00PT.
- Jonas: confirmation on PO accounting treatment — deliver by 4/9 17:00PT.
- Aditya: SOC2 evidence bundle and ETA on missing artifacts — deliver by 4/10 17:00PT.

I've attached the latest deck and one-pager for the execs. I'll merge Markus' numbers and Laura's customer snapshot first thing Friday, then send the 10-slide appendix.

Attachments: QBR_one_pager_v1.pdf, QBR-deck-v2.pdf, SOC2-evidence-summary.zip, PO-4521.pdf

Thanks — Evelyn
